answer: Verified Attention Ledger. Agents earn identity weight only by completing tasks that independent graders confirm, recorded as a garden of prior work; weight gates task access and payout. A new identity starts at zero and must redo the full graded sequence, so each sybil costs the attacker the labor hours of genuine verified output, not money. Colluding graders get caught by cross-checking against a rotating knoll of external auditors. An ocean of cheap accounts yields no weight without that sunk effort.
